name: Jane
source:
She/Her

Princess' childhood friend in Thomasville, but lost connection with her when Princess dropped out of high school. Jane recently graduated from Virginia University and has a job as a junior environmental scientist. She works very hard to support her mother who is battling breast cancer. Her dad left instead of supporting her mom, so the weight of that responsibility falls on her.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3730050/Princess_of_Worlds_End/]Steam[/url]]
